name: Sichuan Xunyou Network Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Xunyou Network Technology Co., Ltd. provides network services for real-time interactive applications in China. The company offers Xunyou and mobile game accelerator, console game acceleration, router plug in, internet cafe management platform, and VR game acceleration products. It also provides advertising display and paid subscription services based on mobile internet application software. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
